purpose: Teach: 希薄/発端/制覇/切実/偏差/弁論/捕獲/子宮

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、地方の人口希薄化を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you were looking at rural depopulation in your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Open, curious inquiry. Warm and present. Steady eye contact. Teacher asking not to test but to hear what the student actually chose.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、紛争の発端を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the origins of conflict.
lines.style: Clear and direct. No performance, no hesitation. Slight nod of ownership. The straightforward answer of someone who has thought this through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: リーグ制覇の戦略を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And the strategic aspects of competitive dominance in the league structure — that's what I remember.
lines.style: Gentle correction or clarification, not contradiction. Thoughtful pause before the second clause. Testing whether Sakura meant something different than what registered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、難民の切実な状況を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Right — but I wrote on the urgent humanitarian situation facing refugees.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Lean slightly forward. The correction of someone who knows her own work and trusts the teacher is listening.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 教育の地域偏差を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: The regional disparities in educational access — that was another direction you explored.
lines.style: Reflective, pulling a thread. Not confirming but opening it. Genuine interest in how many angles Sakura was considering.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、伝統的な弁論術を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I examined traditional rhetoric and argumentation techniques.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact reorientation. No apology in the correction. Calm and specific. The voice of someone clarifying her own intellectual focus.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 絶滅危惧種の捕獲規制を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: The conservation policy around endangered species capture — I thought that's where you were heading.
lines.style: Gentle, genuinely uncertain now. Open invitation for clarity. Teacher backing up to listen more carefully.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、子宮頸がんの予防医療を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No — I actually researched preventive healthcare approaches to cervical cancer.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Final, quiet statement. Emphasis on 'actually' is soft but present. Closing thought, not invitation.
